geometryBenchmark: Decorative drawing datum X=75 mm, equal dot center coordinates 30,60,90,120 mm and Y=37.5 mm. The first pick A→B gives 30 mm, A→D gives 90 mm, A→A gives 0 mm. The mirror maps X to 150−X. Signed delta changes sign; distance, datum and source revision do not.
